item.description:
VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.89

  • Moves Companion Realtime Voice streaming toward server-owned VAD/endpointing so the Companion can auto-send turns after silence instead of relying on iOS to commit every turn.
  • Adds a regression smoke test for WebSocket server VAD auto-commit without a client audio_end message.
  • Makes Kokoro Heart the preferred local TTS default when the HF/MLX runtime is installed, while preserving Piper fallback.
  • Keeps manual send available as a forced commit path for comparison and recovery.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.88

  • Improves Companion Realtime Voice streaming startup reliability by queuing WebSocket messages until the socket is open.
  • Adds Kokoro/MLX local TTS support when the managed HF runtime is available, with Piper fallback.
  • Filters placeholder/noise transcripts such as [BLANK_AUDIO], [no audio], [typing sounds], and one-word "you" before they reach the middle brain.
  • Improves Companion Realtime Voice iPhone-tool routing for Calendar, mute, middle-brain switching, Cerebras model switching, and OpenClaw handoff.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.87

  • Improves Companion Realtime Voice reliability when iOS commits a VAD turn immediately after sending audio.
  • Waits briefly for in-flight WebSocket audio frames before reporting an empty committed turn.
  • Uses the notarized GitHub DMG update path for this release.
